outcome: Help editorial, platform and brand teams assess suspicious media using provenance and forensic signals without treating detection as certainty.
overview: Synthetic and manipulated media now spread faster than any verification desk can respond, while detectors themselves degrade across compression, languages and each new generation of models. This solution gives verification teams one workspace that checks C2PA content credentials and file metadata first, runs multimodal forensic signals, corroborates against external reporting, and presents a confidence range with its evidence rather than a verdict. Every case carries an analyst note, a named editorial decision and an appeal path. An 8–12 week benchmark and pilot establishes performance on the customer’s own known-good and known-bad material — detection assists judgement; publication and takedown decisions stay with humans.

benefits.text: Shorten review time on severe suspected-manipulation cases by triaging provenance and forensic signals in one workspace
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Validated against the desk’s own review-time baseline during the pilot; complex cases still require specialist time — not a guarantee

benefits.text: Increase use of verifiable provenance by checking C2PA content credentials before any forensic inference
benefits.source: Architecture design — provenance verification runs first and is reported separately from forensic scores
benefits.limits: Only assets carrying intact content credentials can be verified this way; absence of provenance is never treated as evidence of manipulation

benefits.text: Preserve human publish, takedown and appeal authority with a documented decision and correction trail for every case
benefits.source: Workflow design — the system produces assessments; only a named reviewer records a decision
benefits.limits: Applies to cases handled through the governed workspace; informal escalations outside it are not covered

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); submitted assets, case evidence and analyst notes remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs, with case material isolated from vendor telemetry and model training

notFor.situation: An automated authenticity verdict is expected without expert review
notFor.why: Detection is probabilistic and degrades against compression, new generators and unfamiliar languages; a score is evidence toward a judgement, never a determination of authorship or intent

notFor.situation: There is no escalation path or trained verification capacity
notFor.why: The workflow ends in a human decision; without analysts and an escalation route, assessments accumulate and nothing is decided

notFor.situation: Output is intended as evidence for accusation or legal proceedings
notFor.why: Forensic scores from this class of tooling do not establish who created an asset or why, and presenting them as proof risks serious harm to individuals

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns verification policy and every publish, label, takedown and appeal decision · Duration: 8–12 week benchmark and pilot; further 16–26 weeks to scaled verification operations
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, forensic integration engineer, data engineer; customer standards owner, verification analyst, trust-and-safety lead, security approver · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Discovery and review-time baseline agreement
2) Benchmark set assembly and labelling with the customer
3) Provenance, forensic and corroboration pipeline build
4) Adversarial, compression and multilingual testing
5) Analyst UAT, escalation drills and controlled rollout
6) Stabilisation, handover and re-benchmark cadence setup
deliverables: Benchmark performance measured and reported per asset type, language and compression profile
Provenance verification behaves correctly for present, stripped and invalid content credentials
Adversarial and recompression tests produce degraded confidence rather than confident errors
Uncertainty is displayed at every decision point and no case can close without a named decision
Incident, correction and appeal workflow demonstrated and analyst UAT complete
effort: 8–12 week benchmark and pilot; further 16–26 weeks to scaled verification operations
languages: Arabic and English audio, on-screen text and contextual corroboration supported; delivery in English with Arabic verification review support
